Finance Team

From raw data to executive briefing — overnight, every Monday.

Before

Monday mornings: 3 hours of manual research, copy-pasting, formatting.

→
After

Monday mornings: a briefing in the inbox. She reads it over coffee.

6 specialised agents · Each agent hands off its output to the next. No prompt needed.
Market Data Collector web_search · scraper

Scrapes competitor pricing, news, and financial filings in real time.

Sentiment Analyst summarise · classify

Reads social mentions, press releases and news tone. Flags what matters.

Financial Modeller code_exec · spreadsheet

Builds comparison tables: margins, headcount, product positioning.

Risk Assessor analyse · flag

Scans for anomalies, regulatory flags, and market risks. Adds a risk score.

Report Writer write · format

Synthesises everything into a clean executive brief with sections and callouts.

Email Formatter email · schedule

Packages the report, adds branding, and sends to your distribution list.

Sarah runs a 12-person accounting firm. She used to spend Monday mornings pulling competitor news, formatting updates, preparing briefs for client meetings.

Now her Finance team runs at 5am while she sleeps. By 7am, a fully sourced, risk-scored competitive briefing is in her inbox — formatted, branded, ready to share. Her clients think she has a research department.

You get
A weekly competitor briefing. Sourced, risk-scored, formatted. Ready to share.

Early feedback

Common questions

Used by consultants, ops leads, and small business owners to automate the work that shouldn't need a human.

Do I need technical knowledge to use these teams?
If you're using a pre-built Synergi template, no. You customise the instructions in plain language and run. Building from scratch requires more care — see How it works →
Can AI screen job applications automatically?
Yes. The HR team uses a 7-agent pipeline: parsing CVs, scoring skills, assessing culture fit, and generating interview questions — all before you open your laptop.
How do I automate my weekly business report?
The Finance team runs a 6-agent sequential pipeline every Monday at 5am. Each agent hands off to the next — data collection, sentiment analysis, modelling, risk flagging, writing, formatting. The report lands in your inbox, sourced and ready to share.
